component.name: Pomodoro98
component.summary: Focus timer with a Windows 98-inspired interface

description.p: Pomodoro98 is a lightweight focus timer styled after classic Windows 98 applications. Work in 25-minute focus sessions followed by 5-minute breaks, without a distracting interface.

ul.li: Start, pause and reset with one click; pausing never loses time
Always-on-top window shows the time left, the current mode and a progress bar
A sound plays when focus and break periods end
Keeps accurate time, even across suspend

screenshot.caption: Pomodoro98 ready to begin a focus session

description.p: A new look for the app icon.

ul.li: New pixel-art tomato icon in the app grid, dock and window.

description.p: First release with the new calendar versioning.

ul.li: The timer keeps accurate time and keeps counting while the computer is suspended.
A wider window, with the mode or "Paused" shown in the window title.
The bell sounds when no audio device can play the alert.
